title: Sleepy hedgehog
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy hedgehog, softly curled, on Doot's dark LED screen -->
  <!-- body / spines as overlapping rounded quills in warm browns -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='24' fill='#6b4a2f'/>
    <!-- spines -->
    <path d='M20 60 Q18 42 30 38 Q34 30 44 34 Q50 26 58 32 Q66 28 70 38 Q82 42 80 58 Q72 50 62 52 Q52 46 42 52 Q30 50 20 60 Z' fill='#8a5a32'/>
    <path d='M26 54 Q26 40 36 38 Q40 32 48 36 Q54 30 60 36 Q68 34 70 42 Q78 46 76 56' fill='none' stroke='#b57a45' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M30 46 Q34 40 40 42 M44 42 Q48 36 54 40 M58 40 Q62 34 68 40 M70 46 Q74 44 76 50' fill='none' stroke='#c98f56' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='68' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#e8c79a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='72' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#f2d6b0'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='71' r='3' fill='#4a2e1c'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eye -->
  <path d='M68 66 Q73 71 78 66' fill='none' stroke='#4a2e1c' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='75' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f0a0a0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- little ear -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='55' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#d9a878'/>
  <!-- paw tucked under chin -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f2d6b0'/>
  <!-- sleep bubbles -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='48' r='3' fill='#a8d8ff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='39' r='4' fill='#a8d8ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='28' r='5' fill='#a8d8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
